name: C.A.M.P.
oracle_text:
Whenever fortified land is tapped for mana, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. If that creature shares a color with the mana that land produced, create a Junk token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Exile the top card of your library. You may play that card this turn. Activate only as a sorcery.")
Fortify {3} ({3}: Attach to target land you control. Fortify only as a sorcery.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever fortified land is tapped for mana, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. If that creature shares a color with the mana that land produced, create a Junk token.

needs.what: a non-mana triggered ability (uses the stack, may target) that fires whenever the permanent this source is attached to is tapped for mana -- on every tap, including the lands the payment solver taps -- and binds the mana that tap produced so effects can read its colors
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `tapped_permanent` key with `attached`/`produced` only drives the inline added-mana statics (Wild Growth style) that resolve inside payment and can only add mana; `becomes_tapped` is any tap, and `ability_activated` with `mana_ability: true` is fired only on the by-hand mana path (game.py says solver-tapped lands emit nothing) and carries no produced mana

needs.what: a condition "target creature shares a color with the mana that land produced", comparing a target's colors against the colors of the mana bound by the tapped-for-mana trigger
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `two_share_a_color` compares objects matched by one selector, and `colors_of_mana_spent` reads mana spent on a spell, not mana produced by a land's tap
